decision_relevance.result_summary: Across the full 1,800-record cohort, P and H produce the same stack selection, complete ordering, and pairwise preferences at cutoffs 1, 5, and 20 within every hosted-model family and under pooled-record, equal-model, and equal-question aggregation. On the conditioned 329-record canonical-mismatch subset, the maximizing stack set differs once: at cutoff 1, P ties ColBERTv2 with the final hybrid reranker while H selects body-only BM25. This is a conditional diagnostic result rather than a changed full-cohort stack choice or reader-outcome result.

definition.H_at_k: the canonical dataset-traced-object PID occurs in the same named recorded top-k ranking
definition.P_at_k: the canonical selected-object PID occurs in the named recorded top-k ranking; false when the selected ID is absent or unresolvable
definition.complete_ordering_change: the exact high-to-low stack tier partition differs between P and H
definition.primary_population: all 1,800 planned records; invalid or corpus-unresolvable selected IDs are P misses, and upstream-invalid empty rankings are H misses
definition.scope: retrospective deterministic accounting on frozen rankings; no reader outcome, semantic-correctness, causal, or deployment claim
definition.stack_selection_decision: the set of stacks attaining the largest exact rate for the named metric, population, aggregation, and cutoff

inputs.container_policy: bind exact scientific member bytes, not the outer ZIP
